entries.title: Claude work resumes once Claude is serving again
entries.body: A pause that started because Claude could not read its sign-in no longer waits until you remove the account and add it again. Once Claude accepts that same sign-in, the work goes out on its own. While the pause stands, the Claude row says so, and Sign in clears it.

picture.alt: Settings, Intelligence: the Claude row shows live allowance meters, an on-hold mark, and Sign in
